title: 箱子上的纸牌  (The Luggage Tag)

segments.t: Back at the front desk, Qing, Teacher Song, and Manager Zhou lean over the blue suitcase beneath the desk lamp. Zhou finally puts his reading glasses to work. Listen first.
哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
'Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.'
上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
'Is there a name or a phone number on it?'
可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
'Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.'
等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
'Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!'
真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
'How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.'
小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
'Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.'
我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
'I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?'
告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
'Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!'
还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
'Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!'
宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
'Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.'
不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
'It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!'
等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
'Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

Still no word from the train station, yet the mysterious owner knows a lane just five minutes away. Next time, Mei steps in to rescue Teacher Song's evening. See you next time.
再见！
